title: Every Fight Is Followed By A Century

runtime.timing: requestAnimationFrame with variable delta capped at 50ms; window.advanceTime exposes fixed 60Hz stepping for observation
runtime.input: DOM keyboard events interpreted directly in src/main.ts; no logical action layer yet
runtime.camera: simple third-person chase camera; no collision avoidance, sensitivity settings, or shake setting
runtime.physics: application-owned kinematic approximation; no rigid-body physics or structure solver
runtime.combat: player strike/shockwave and a pursuing rival; no player damage or environmental enemy destruction
runtime.destruction: building-height reduction/visibility changes and visual scar discs; no support graph, bridge failure, or active debris
runtime.persistence: localStorage campaign envelope; no schema migration, corruption handling, or IndexedDB
runtime.tests: Vitest source/helper checks and direct Playwright startup smoke; no complete player-journey evidence

truthBoundary: The active entry is an experimental Three.js/WebGL slice. Its compact history and deep-time helpers are not the canonical 100,000-year campaign world; all later phase systems remain provisional until their completion contracts are proven.
